defects.source_says: The cited report cover and transmittal letter are dated September 1, 1949 ("SAN FRANCISCO, CALIF., September 1,1949"); the order was signed July 20, 1949, so a 1946 end precedes the order itself. The clause judgment_reason also says 1949-09-01, so the claim is internally inconsistent.
Thirty days after the 1949-09-01 report is 1949-10-01 (inclusive); the judgment_reason itself computes 1949-10-01. 1946-10-01 predates the order.
The latest clause end supported by the sources is 1949-10-01; research_rationale states "Whole-order end 1949-10-01".
